title.description: Conventional Commits title: type(scope): subject. Imperative, no trailing period.

draft_path.description: Absolute path of the markdown file written, which must be the output path given in the task.

outline.description: The headings written, in order, so the author can see the shape without opening the file.

unused.description: Brief facts deliberately left out, with the reason. Empty array if everything was used.

gaps.description: Specific details the brief lacked, including anything you had to read the repository to resolve. Empty array if none.
